entries.short_description: Review (Roodman, Massenkoff) of 56 randomized US studies: training raises employment 2–3 pts and earnings ~$1,000/yr for ~$13,000 cost, roughly breaking even; existing programs would likely fall short under large-scale AI displacement.
entries.title: Anthropic: How well do job retraining programs work? (Anthropic Economic Research evidence review)

entries.title: Anthropic: Claude has improved on a longstanding lower bound for the fraction of zeros of the Riemann zeta function that satisfy the Riemann hypothesis
